artifact.authoring: Independent wording written for P8; no Round-3 case id or Round-3 sentence is used. Each expectation is hand-checked against the cited ruling. Observations are merged over the harness base (Remote - India, Base: INR 30 LPA, Full-time permanent, owner-classified PRODUCT unless stated) and raw_text is appended to a STRONG-relevance JD so the lane reflects eligibility.
artifact.mutation: remove_fix names the fix family removed in memory (tests/p8_mutations.py restores the 0.2.4 data for that family). fails_without_fix = true means the case's verdict, rule or lane differs without the fix (the case exercises the fix); false marks a regression guard that must hold either way.
artifact.jd_prefix: You will build RAG pipelines with embeddings and vector retrieval, run LLM evaluation for groundedness and faithfulness on golden datasets, and add guardrails against hallucination.

queue_scenarios.description: Queue below the cap at D+3: the non-STRONG carried item is PARKED (OR-88).
Queue exactly at the cap at D+3 (9 new + the carried item): the carried item is PARKED (OR-88).
Queue over the cap at D+3: PARKED under both readings.
STRONG item carried to D+3 with free capacity is shown, never PARKED (OR-29).
D, D+1, D+2 carry: an item that overflowed on D is carried, not parked, and is eligible again (OR-65).
